nodes.label: QueueFlow System
nodes.rationale: Real-time queue management system for multi-office service desks. Centralized ticket issuance, per-office displays, operator controls, supervisor oversight. Built on Next.js, Upstash Redis, SSE.

nodes.label: Next.js 16 (App Router)
nodes.rationale: Framework choice enables server-side rendering, API routes, and edge deployment on Vercel with zero-config caching.

nodes.label: Upstash Redis
nodes.rationale: Serverless Redis for all state storage per office. Free tier supports ~1000 RPS, sufficient for 8 offices under modest load.

nodes.label: Server-Sent Events
nodes.rationale: Used for public display boards to push real-time updates every 1-2 seconds, reducing polling overhead. Scales linearly with display count.

nodes.label: SWR Polling
nodes.rationale: Client-side polling at 1.5-2 second intervals for operator panels; balances responsiveness vs API load.

nodes.label: React 19
nodes.rationale: UI library for building interactive components with server components via Next.js App Router.

nodes.label: Tailwind CSS 4
nodes.rationale: Utility-first CSS using semantic design tokens (--color-*, --radius). Prefer gap over margin/padding spacing.

nodes.label: shadcn/ui
nodes.rationale: Component library for base UI primitives (dialogs, buttons, selectors, modals).

nodes.label: Framer Motion
nodes.rationale: Animation library for transitions and UI interactions.

nodes.label: Figtree Font
nodes.rationale: Sans-serif typeface (400-600 weight) used for headings and body copy, part of Swiss design aesthetic.

nodes.label: DM Mono Font
nodes.rationale: Monospace typeface used for numbers, codes, and labels.

nodes.label: Swiss Graphic Design Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Grid-based layout, clean typography, functional minimalism. Influences typography choices (Figtree, DM Mono) and dark mode presentation.

nodes.label: Dark Mode Design
nodes.rationale: Primary aesthetic choice: black (#0A0A0A) background, off-white (#F0EDE8) foreground, amber (#F5A623) accent. Reduces eye strain for operators working in dim environments.

nodes.label: Design System Color Tokens
nodes.rationale: Semantic tokens: Primary #F5A623 Amber, Background #0A0A0A Black, Foreground #F0EDE8 Off-white, Card #111111, Border #222222, Muted #6B6B6B. Per-office colors (HR Green, FIN Orange, REG Blue, etc.) for visual distinction.

nodes.label: Ticket Lifecycle States
nodes.rationale: Six states: Waiting (issued, queue position) -> Called (operator announces) -> Serving (at counter) -> Done (complete, eligible for transfer) -> Hold (paused for documents) -> Skipped (returned to waiting). Transfer maintains same ticket ID across offices.

nodes.label: Redis Data Model
nodes.rationale: Four keys per office: queue:{office}:tickets (JSON array of Ticket objects), queue:{office}:next_seq (incrementing integer), queue:{office}:serving (counter->ticket map), queue:{office}:counters (active count).

nodes.label: PIN Authentication
nodes.rationale: 4-digit PIN per office (ADMIN_PIN_{OFFICE}) plus universal ADMIN_PIN fallback. Supervisor uses ADMIN_PIN only. Per-office PINs override universal if set.

nodes.label: Kiosk Auto-reset
nodes.rationale: After 30 seconds of inactivity, the kiosk returns to the office grid to prevent lingering on stale screens in public kiosk mode.

nodes.label: Central Kiosk
nodes.rationale: Route /kiosk. Unified ticket issuance with office card grid showing live queue depth and estimated wait times. Auto-resets after 30s inactivity.

nodes.label: Per-Office Display Board
nodes.rationale: Route /display/[office]. Shows Now Serving with counter assignments and Next Up indicator. Live SSE updates every 1-2 seconds. Designed for office TVs.

nodes.label: Operator Panel
nodes.rationale: Route /operator/[office]. PIN-protected. Actions: Call Next, Serve, Complete, Hold, Skip, Transfer, Re-call. Counter selection header. SWR polling every 1.5s.

nodes.label: Supervisor Dashboard
nodes.rationale: Route /supervisor. Bird's-eye view: office cards with queue depth, avg wait, served count. Add/remove counters, track idle counters, reset office, export CSV.

nodes.label: Ticket Transfer
nodes.rationale: Transfer done tickets to other offices while preserving ticket ID (e.g., FI-001 stays FI-001). Removed from source, added as fresh Waiting in destination.

nodes.label: CSV Export
nodes.rationale: Supervisor can download full queue history as CSV for reporting and analysis.
